The folklore that touching a toad gives you warts is a myth. Human warts are caused by human papillomavirus (HPV), which is not carried by toads, and the bumps on a toad’s skin are glandular, not viral. While some toads secrete mild irritants that can cause temporary skin irritation, they do not cause warts or any lasting effect.
